sections.title: باب 4 — متن (18)

paras.text: 2. Arbitrating or getting negotiation done is an art; therefore the mediator should have the ability to understand the psychology of the parties. The mediator’s attention should be on this, from what angles the parties like to see things in the future. The mediator should go forward keeping his hand on the pulse of the parties.
paras.urdu: ۲۔ ثالثی کرنا، گفت و شنید کرنا یا کروانا ایک ہنر ہے لہٰذا ثالث کو فریقین کی نفسیات سمجھنے کی صلاحیت ہونی چاہیئے۔ ثالث کی توجہ اِس بات پر ہو کہ فریقین مستقبل میں چیزوں کو کن زاویوں سے دیکھنا پسند کرتے ہیں۔ ثالث کو فریقین کی نبض پر ہاتھ رکھ کر آگے جانا چاہیئے۔
paras.pashto: ۲. منځګړیتوب کول، خبرې اترې کول یا کول ورکول یو هنر دی، نو منځګړی باید د اړخونو د ارواپوهنې د پوهېدو وړتیا ولري. د منځګړي پاملرنه دې پر دې وي چې اړخونه په راتلونکي کې شیانو ته له کومو زاویو کتل خوښوي. منځګړی دې د اړخونو پر نبض لاس کېږدي او مخکې ولاړ شي.

paras.text: 3. A good mediator should be experienced. The more experience, the more quickly and easily the matter will be solved. Therefore the mediator should be experienced, cool-tempered and patient. If he is emotional and hot-tempered, then instead of the issue being solved it can become worse.
paras.urdu: ۳۔ ایک اچھے ثالث کیلئے تجربہ کار ہونا چاہیئے۔ تجربہ جتنا زیادہ ہوگا معاملہ اُتنا ہی جلدی اور آسانی سے حل ہوگا۔ اِسلئے ثالث تجربہ کار، سرد مزاج اور صابر ہونا چاہیئے۔ اگر وہ جذباتی اور گرم مزاج ہو تو مسئلہ حل ہونے کی بجائے مزید خراب ہو سکتا ہے۔
paras.pashto: ۳. یو ښه منځګړی باید تجربه‌کار وي. څومره چې تجربه ډېره وي، چاره هومره ژر او اسانه حلېږي. له همدې امله منځګړی باید تجربه‌کار، سړه مزاجه او صابر وي. که احساساتي او تود مزاجه وي، مسئله د حل پر ځای لا خرابېدای شي.

paras.text: 4. The environment has a great effect on negotiations, talks and arbitration. The mediator or negotiator should have the ability to keep an eye on the environment. The mediator should keep the environment under his control but should not try to influence the participants and the decision.
paras.urdu: ۴۔ مذاکرات، بات چیت اور ثالثی پر ماحول کا بہت اثر ہوتا ہے۔ ثالث یا مذاکرات کار کیلئے ماحول پر نظر رکھنے کی صلاحیت ہونی چاہیئے۔ ثالث ماحول کو اپنے قابو میں رکھے لیکن ماحول، شرکاء اور فیصلہ پر اثر انداز ہونے کی کوشش نہ کرے۔
paras.pashto: ۴. پر خبرو اترو، مذاکراتو او منځګړیتوب د چاپېریال ډېر اغېز وي. منځګړي یا مذاکره‌کوونکي ته باید پر چاپېریال د څارنې وړتیا وي. منځګړی دې چاپېریال په خپل واک کې وساتي، خو پر چاپېریال، ګډونوالو او پرېکړې د اغېز هڅه دې ونه کړي.

paras.text: 5. It is necessary for the mediator that he ensures a moderate, calm, safe and pleasant environment.
paras.urdu: ۵۔ ثالث کیلئے ضروری ہے کہ وہ ایک معتدل، پُرسکون، محفوظ اور خوشگوار ماحول کو یقینی بنائے۔
paras.pashto: ۵. منځګړي ته اړینه ده چې یو معتدل، ارام، خوندي او خوشحاله چاپېریال ډاډمن کړي.

paras.text: 6. It is also necessary for the mediator to be a person of character. The mediator should play such a role that both parties are satisfied with his character.
paras.urdu: ۶۔ ثالث کیلئے صاحبِ کردار ہونا بھی لازمی ہے۔ ثالث ایسا کردار ادا کرے کہ دونوں فریقین اُس کے کردار سے مطمئن ہوں۔
paras.pashto: ۶. منځګړي ته د کرکټر خاوند کېدل هم لازم دي. منځګړی دې داسې رول ولوبوي چې دواړه اړخونه یې له کرکټر مطمئن وي.

paras.text: 7. It is necessary for the negotiator that he is expert in those matters on which there is difference, so that the root of the issue can be reached easily. It is also extremely important for the mediator to be just.
paras.urdu: ۷۔ مذاکرات کار کیلئے ضروری ہے کہ جن معاملات پر اِختلاف ہو وہ اُن معاملات میں ماہر ہو تاکہ مسئلے کی جڑ تک آسانی سے پہنچا جا سکے۔ ثالث کیلئے اِنصاف پسند ہونا بھی بے حد اہم ہے۔
paras.pashto: ۷. مذاکره‌کوونکي ته اړینه ده چې په هغو چارو کې ماهر وي چې پرې اختلاف دی ترڅو د مسئلې ریښې ته په اسانۍ ورسېږي. منځګړي ته د عدالت‌پال کېدل هم ډېر مهم دي.

paras.text: 8. The mediator should be just and educated.
paras.urdu: ۸۔ ثالث اِنصاف پسند اور تعلیم یافتہ ہونا چاہیئے۔
paras.pashto: ۸. منځګړی دې عدالت‌پال او لوستی وي.

The aim of human life is that peace be established in human society. If closeness to those who arbitrate and negotiate is obtained and their activities are watched, then this art can be learned. For this purpose observation and study is also very necessary, through which knowledge of the requisites of arbitration and negotiation can be obtained …

sections.theory:
2. Arbitrating or getting negotiation done is an art; therefore the mediator should have the ability to understand the psychology of the parties. The mediator’s attention should be on this, from what angles the parties like to see things in the future. The mediator should go forward keeping his hand on the pulse of the parties.

3. A good mediator should be experienced. The more experience, the more quickly and easily the matter will be solved. Therefore the mediator should be experienced, cool-tempered and patient. If he is emotional and hot-tempered, then instead of the issue being solved it can become worse.

4. The environment has a great effect on negotiations, talks and arbitration. The mediator or negotiator should have the ability to keep an eye on the environment. The mediator should keep the environment under his control but should not try to influence the participants and the decision.

5. It is necessary for the mediator that he ensures a moderate, calm, safe and pleasant environment.

6. It is also necessary for the mediator to be a person of character. The mediator should play such a role that both parties are satisfied with his character.

7. It is necessary for the negotiator that he is expert in those matters on which there is difference, so that the root of the issue can be reached easily. It is also extremely important for the mediator to be just.

8. The mediator should be just and educated.

How to Adopt Qualities of A Good Mediator and Negotiator

Every human being can adopt the qualities of a good mediator and negotiator. The first thing is that in every human being there should be the spirit of resolving problems and conflicts. The aim of human life is that peace be established in human society. If closeness to those who arbitrate and negotiate is obtained and their activities are watched, then this art can be learned. For this purpose observation and study is also very necessary, through which knowledge of the requisites of arbitration and negotiation can be obtained …

2. Arbitrating or getting negotiation done is an art; therefore the mediator should have the ability to understand the psychology of the parties. The mediator’s attention should be on this, from what angles the parties like to see things in the future. The mediator should go forward keeping his hand on the pulse of the parties.

3. A good mediator should be experienced. The more experience, the more quickly and easily the matter will be solved. Therefore the mediator should be experienced, cool-tempered and patient. If he is emotional and hot-tempered, then instead of the issue being solved it can become worse.

4. The environment has a great effect on negotiations, talks and arbitration. The mediator or negotiator should have the ability to keep an eye on the environment. The mediator should keep the environment under his control but should not try to influence the participants and the decision.

5. It is necessary for the mediator that he ensures a moderate, calm, safe and pleasant environment.

6. It is also necessary for the mediator to be a person of character. The mediator should play such a role that both parties are satisfied with his character.

7. It is necessary for the negotiator that he is expert in those matters on which there is difference, so that the root of the issue can be reached easily. It is also extremely important for the mediator to be just.

8. The mediator should be just and educated.

How to Adopt Qualities of A Good Mediator and Negotiator

Every human being can adopt the qualities of a good mediator and negotiator. The first thing is that in every human being there should be the spirit of resolving problems and conflicts. The aim of human life is that peace be established in human society. If closeness to those who arbitrate and negotiate is obtained and their activities are watched, then this art can be learned. For this purpose observation and study is also very necessary, through which knowledge of the requisites of arbitration and negotiation can be obtained …

sections.title: باب 4 — متن (19)

paras.text: … can be obtained. One should take part in the arbitration and negotiation activities taking place in one’s own home, family and village or city, and keep every aspect in view. To become a mediator there should be a spirit of sacrifice. One should be a selfless servant. The best mediator or negotiator can be the one who has in him the courage to give human and financial sacrifice, because in this path a person has to pay the price of personal loss too. Justice should be made a necessary part of life, because the aim of arbitration and negotiation is the just decision of the conflict. To become a mediator, besides law and customs, acquaintance with religious commands and teachings is also necessary, because most decisions have to be made in the light of law, customs and religious principles. Good decisions are those that become the durable solution of conflicts. The qualities of a mediator or negotiator have been stated above. If most of these qualities are adopted, then anyone can become a mediator and negotiator. It is necessary for a good citizen that he has the ability of arbitration of conflicts and talks between parties.

sections.pashto: … شي. په خپل کور، کورنۍ او کلي یا ښار کې د منځګړیتوب او خبرو اترو په فعالیتونو کې برخه واخیستل شي او هر اړخ ته پام وشي. د منځګړي کېدو لپاره د قربانۍ جذبه پکار ده. بې‌غرضه خدمتګار باید وي. غوره منځګړی یا خبرې اترې کوونکی هغه کېدای شي چې په دې لاره کې د ځاني او مالي قربانۍ وړتیا ولري، ځکه یو کس ته د شخصي زیان بیه ورکول پکار کېږي. عدالت‌پالنه باید د ژوند لازمي برخه شي، ځکه د منځګړیتوب او خبرو اترو موخه د شخړې عادلانه پرېکړه ده. د منځګړي کېدو لپاره له قانون او دودونو سربېره له دیني حکمونو او لارښوونو خبرتیا هم اړینه ده، ځکه ډېرې پرېکړې د قانون، دودونو او دیني اصولو په رڼا کې کېږي او د شخړو داسې حلونه پایښت لرونکي وي. د منځګړي یا خبرې اترې کوونکي ځانګړنې مخکې بیان شوې. که د دې ډېرې ځانګړنې غوره شي، هر کس منځګړی او خبرې اترې کوونکی کېدای شي. د یوه ښه تبعه لپاره لازمه ده چې د شخړو د منځګړیتوب او د اړخونو ترمنځ د خبرو وړتیا ولري.

sections.content: … can be obtained. One should take part in the arbitration and negotiation activities taking place in one’s own home, family and village or city, and keep every aspect in view. To become a mediator there should be a spirit of sacrifice. One should be a selfless servant. The best mediator or negotiator can be the one who has in him the courage to give human and financial sacrifice, because in this path a person has to pay the price of personal loss too. Justice should be made a necessary part of life, because the aim of arbitration and negotiation is the just decision of the conflict. To become a mediator, besides law and customs, acquaintance with religious commands and teachings is also necessary, because most decisions have to be made in the light of law, customs and religious principles. Good decisions are those that become the durable solution of conflicts. The qualities of a mediator or negotiator have been stated above. If most of these qualities are adopted, then anyone can become a mediator and negotiator. It is necessary for a good citizen that he has the ability of arbitration of conflicts and talks between parties.
